info.description: Qaturia CRM API v2. Send Accept: application/json. Protected operations accept Sanctum bearer tokens or a stateful frontend session. Session writes require the CSRF cookie and X-XSRF-TOKEN header. Tenant and permissions are resolved by the authenticated user; X-Team-ID can only confirm the current team. Monetary inputs use major currency units; inspect each resource for serialized amounts. See docs/API_CONTRACTS.md for restrictions and known inference limitations.

post.description: Each event has an independent result. The entire persistence transaction commits before acknowledgment; a 503 acknowledges none and must be retried unchanged. Captions and viewer-picks diagnostics are disabled by default. Source timestamps retain supplied provenance; local observation times are not official TikTok times. Events without stable source IDs only deduplicate transport retries. See docs/LIVE_API.md.
